title: Sharks Can Hear Sounds Nearly 250 Feet Away

scenes.text: Sharks can hear a sound from nearly 250 feet away.
Scientists tested blacktip sharks off Florida.
They used an underwater speaker drifting from a boat, and a drone above.
The sharks reacted to low rumbling sounds from about 243 feet away.
They ignored a high-pitched control sound.
And they quickly changed course, so they could tell where it came from.
That is about two and a half basketball courts. Quiet water is not quiet to a shark.

description:
Sharks can hear a sound from nearly 250 feet away.
Blacktip sharks off Florida reacted to low-frequency sounds from about 243 feet away and changed direction in response.
Would you swim in a quiet ocean?
first_comment: Bonus: they did not react to a high-pitched control sound at all. Which animal's senses amaze you most?
